race.comment: ATOMIC TIME (1) has recently been bought out of Queensland and joins the in-form Stephen Theodore stable who usually gets immediate results with similar types. Harry Grace is up, and we put him on top. BUFFO (2) was put away for a spell after racing greenly on debut and finishing fifth at Donald in early May. He was close up in a recent trial, and having Jacob Opperman on board is a strong lead, so watch that market closely. SNOBZ (14) was also a beaten favourite on debut, and he has won both of his tune-up trials this time, and it is only a wide draw that is the query. SEND IT AGAIN (11) makes her debut and she is trained on the course. A good draw is an assist, so keep an eye on the market movers.
